beforeSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, capacity
FROM warehouses
ORDER BY capacity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
afterSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, capacity
FROM warehouses
ORDER BY capacity DESC
LIMIT 1;

beforeSql: SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) FILTER (WHERE r.reason_code = 'LATE'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS late_delivery_ratio FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 201
afterSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS late_delivery_ratio FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 201

beforeSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM product_price_history pph
  WHERE pph.product_id = p.product_id
);
afterSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS never_changed_product_count
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM product_price_history h
    WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
      AND h.old_price IS DISTINCT FROM h.new_price
);

beforeSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

-- 统计各会员等级中被打上流失风险标签的会员人数
SELECT m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS churn_risk_members
FROM members m
JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
WHERE ut.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK'
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY churn_risk_members DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql: SELECT ml.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM member_levels ml LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = ml.level_id LEFT JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id AND utm.tag_id = (SELECT tag_id FROM user_tags WHERE tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK') GROUP BY ml.level_id ORDER BY ml.level_id LIMIT 201

beforeSql:
SELECT tc.category_name,
       st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY tc.category_name, st.priority
ORDER BY tc.category_name, st.priority
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT st.category_id,
       st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY st.category_id, st.priority
ORDER BY st.category_id, st.priority
LIMIT 200;

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS low_score_rate
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY low_score_rate DESC
LIMIT 10;
